validation: Checked with the structural catalogue gate and deterministic re-authoring. The worked example passes the bundled checker with zero findings, and the checker flagged all 20 seeded defects on mutated copies. Three checker defects found during benchmarking were fixed. The checker tests completeness and consistency, not design quality. Bundle benchmark 04/11/26 (whole persona core vs no skill, one frontier model, isolated no-tool sessions, deterministic scorers): all 9 closed decision cases at ceiling in both arms; three open design tasks, two trials each: webhook service 5/7, 5/7 -> 6/7, 6/7; AI support assistant 7/9, 5/9 -> 9/9, 8/9; right-sizing an analytics stack 5/6, 5/6 -> 6/6, 6/6 (rubric-only tie; difference is the document standard). Skilled answers were 2-3x longer and slower. Scorer and checker corrections recorded. Results apply to the bundle as a whole; controller-authored cases, not independent review.
sources: Principles distilled from: Google, The Site Reliability Workbook, Non-Abstract Large System Design (free online); Alex Xu, System Design Interview vol. 1, author-hosted framework chapter; system-design-primer (CC BY 4.0); AWS Well-Architected Framework pillars; Microsoft Azure Architecture Center patterns (CC BY 4.0). Paraphrased; no source text reproduced. The bundled template, example and checker are original.
